summary: Round 2 re-checked the one failed item, regression:perf-skirt-tris, and it now passes. The served GLBs are the rebuilt ones: in dist-catalog, the skirt_rift and skirt_rift_low files have the same shasum as art/out. A GLB parse gives skirt_rift 9,721 tris (body 2,873 + trees 6,848) and skirt_rift_low 4,451 tris (897 + 3,554). I re-measured in real Chrome at RIFT High (t 900, seed 7) using the round-1 method: renderer.profile() over every pass, with the 40 skirt and camp-lip landmarks shown and then hidden in the same frame. The skirt cost is 12,973 triangles at the south edge (target 30k; was 119,080) and 28,219 at the pinned low-road fight. That fight frame is 330,059 triangles; this run's dynamic fight, also on the low road, is 379,618, both under the 500k budget. Every lane bend, gate and spawn I sampled costs 0-14.2k. perf_1080 --prod passes the fixed-view budgets (High 295k, Low 241k), but the gate fails overall on its match-peak section. At the worst frame (857,686 triangles at 1099.5 s), actors are 741k and landmarks 25k, and the 41-program miss happened at 14 s. That cause is outside W5a and is listed under regressions. Out-of-bounds skirt pixels in the refix shots read L* p50 13-14 and p95 at most 23.3, so the done:3 value band holds.

- dist-catalog/assets/80f354cc5c3c-skirt_rift.glb and 2fc4fe5631fe-skirt_rift_low.glb have the same shasum as art/out/maps/landmarks/skirt_rift*.glb (a5ae1a36, 8e38e519), and catalog.json references them.

Re-measure: my own script, the round-1 fw_W5a_ver1_edgecount.mjs method plus a loaded-geometry check and a main/shadow split (scratchpad fw_W5a_ver2_edgecount.mjs). - South edge (85,110): 12,973 (8,902 main + 4,071 shadow), target <= 30k. Round 1 measured 119,080.
- Pinned low-road fight (101.52,95.6): 28,219 (8,902 main + 19,317 shadow). The frame is 330,059 (304,891 hidden), under 500k; round 1 was 569,907.
- s_edge_w (40,110): 13,663. s_edge_e (130,110): 12,973.
- High road (85,11.5): 17,023. W/E edges (0,55)/(170,55): 20,998.
- SW/SE corners: 29,769 / 30,459. n_edge (85,0): 33,592.
- NW/NE corners (0,0)/(170,0): 59,894 / 58,565. These are beyond the 4 m camera clamp, and those frames total at most 182k.
- Dynamic b.fight(), at (103.1,96.5) on the low road this run: 13,663; frame 379,618.

Lane sweep (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver2_edge_counts_lanes.log):
- High-road bends (32.3,23.4) and (26.2,30.1): 6,086 and 4,202.
- Low-road bends (32.3,86.6) and (26.2,79.9): 1,927 and 4,202.

perf_1080 --prod --no-dyn --no-mem (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver2_perf_1080.json/.log):
- Fixed view: High 295k tris, 177 draws, 39 programs; Low 241k, 142 draws, 27 programs. Both within the hard budgets. The timing targets were not measured because the machine was busy (load 15-23).
- The overall GATE FAILs on the match-peak section. That failure is not the skirts; see regressions.

Looks (refix shots and renders, viewed):
- art/renders/maps/skirt_rift.png and skirt_rift_low.png: coursed copings, flagged rim walk, crowns per terrace.
- _harness/_shots/fw_W5a_ref1_rift_edge_at0-5.png: south rim walk and young bed, north coursed wall, NW/SW corners, low road. No holes or missing faces are visible.
- Out-of-bounds L* (fw_W5a_ver1_lstar.py): at0 south band p50 12.9 / p95 22.8; at4 west strip 13.3 / 22.9 and south band 14.3 / 23.0; at3 west strip 13.9 / 23.3. 0 % of pixels above 52, so done:3 still holds.

Refix scope: commit 12a9dde4 touches only skirts.py, landmarks/skirt_rift*.glb, build_report_skirts.json and the two renders, all W5a paths. landmarks_art2.flags() gained ch=0.025, which equals the old hard-coded chamfer, so other landmarks are byte-for-byte unaffected. npm run content:check: OK, 1 warning.

Minors:
- The low-road shadow-pass share varies by run: 19,317 here vs 6,297 in the refix log, a 28.2k total against the 30k bar.
- The W1 'shadow: false' handoff for off-map skirts was not raised. It would remove 4-21k shadow tris per view, about 28k at the W1 polish2 spawn frame. It is optional now.

regressions:
Out of lane (W1, render perf), not caused by W5a: perf_1080 --prod GATE FAIL on its match-peak section (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver2_perf_1080.json).
- Peak 857,686 triangles at 1099.5 s; 21 seconds over 500k (336.9, 340.9, 881.8, then 1014.9-1099.5 s).
- At the profiled peaks, actors are 477-741k and VFX 34-67k, while landmarks are only 18.8-24.5k (1019 s: 688,809 total / 24,505 landmarks; 1099.5 s: 846,907 / 24,519).
- The seconds at 336.9 and 340.9 (535k / 501k) carry 130-140 actors, 183-226 VFX and 776-902 particles: a teamfight.
- Peak programs 41 > 40 at 14 s.
- W1's own runs (fw_W1_perf_1080_polish.json 814k, polish2.json 858k) show the same actor-driven peak.
- Hiding every landmark would not bring these frames under 500k: the largest skirt cost measured on any lane or spawn is 14.2k.
- The fixed views pass: High 295k, Low 241k.
